item.title: Danantara BUMN Karya crisis deepens; Indonesia electricity subsidy surges 17.8%
item.description: Indonesia's state construction firms face hundred-trillion rupiah debts and delisting threats while the government simultaneously commits to a sharply higher electricity subsidy bill — two fiscal pressures that will test Danantara's restructuring credibility.
